propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO which do not exist in live Jira, causing jql_active to issue rejected queries (project = LEG AND status != "Done") and ACLI to abort with parse error

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out reads all keys from projects.json and issues one inbound JQL query per key; a single nonexistent key causes the entire reconcile pass to fail with exit 1

The canonical intended state for live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json is {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} (empty projects), which enables fallback to the single configured project REB

The .bridge_state/projects.json write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project → _write_record) lacks unified store write lock, auto-commit, and auto-push, enabling ad-hoc hand-commits (commits 9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e by test-fixture identity) that corrupted live state

Remediation included per-project fan-out resilience, preflight visibility verification, bridge-state writes adopting shared write_lock + commit+push, and read-only 'bridge fsck --live-visibility' diagnostic

Production verification confirmed: live projects.json restored to canonical, rebar bridge preview against REB completed green without JQL parse error, and subsequent scheduled Reconcile Bridge runs complete successfully
